nodes.description: Address stored in state variable `core` on XDEX; owner/authorized minter of the token.
Public function setCore(address _core) guarded by onlyCore; transfers the privileged core role to a new address.
Public function mint(address account, uint256 amount) guarded by onlyCore; mints new tokens to an arbitrary account.
External function burnForSelf(uint256 amount); burns tokens from the caller's own balance with no access control.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as the burn source.
Internal state-changing _mint(account, amount) invocation inside mint that increases balances and total supply.
Internal state-changing _burn(msg.sender, amount) invocation inside burnForSelf that decreases balances and total supply.
ERC20 mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances, mutated by _mint and _burn.
ERC20 uint256 total supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Parameter _core of setCore; new privileged address written into state variable core.
Parameter account of mint; destination address receiving newly minted tokens.
Parameter amount of mint; quantity of tokens created via _mint arithmetic.
Parameter amount of burnForSelf; quantity of caller tokens destroyed via _burn arithmetic.

edges.reason: onlyCore modifier on setCore requires msg.sender == core, so the untrusted caller directly gates privileged role transfer.
onlyCore modifier on mint requires msg.sender == core, making the untrusted caller the authorization gate for token creation.
setCore writes the new address into the privileged state variable core, changing who passes onlyCore.
Parameter _core flows into the core state variable assignment inside setCore.
mint invokes the internal _mint state-changing operation.
Parameter account flows into mint and is forwarded to _mint as the recipient.
Parameter amount flows into mint and is used in SafeMath addition arithmetic in _mint.
_mint adds amount to _balances[account], an arithmetic state mutation.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount via SafeMath addition.
burnForSelf uses msg.sender as the burned account with no authorization check, letting any caller destroy its own balance.
burnForSelf invokes the internal _burn state-changing operation.
Parameter amount flows into burnForSelf and drives the SafeMath subtraction in _burn.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances[msg.sender], an arithmetic state mutation.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by amount via SafeMath subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _core exists only to be written into the core state variable by the setCore function, so it normalizes into that core function node.
Parameter account is solely the mint recipient forwarded to _mint, so it collapses into the mint function node.
Parameter amount is only consumed by the mint function's arithmetic via _mint, so it merges into the mint function node.
Parameter amount is used exclusively by burnForSelf to compute the burn quantity, so it collapses into that core function node.
